title: Please help me and my son reach the 1000 wishlists before the Steam Fest with our first game!
author: awezoomstudios
selftext:
Hi! We are Dad and Son Games Studios, and this is our first commercial release. We've been working in the game for almost a year and we are struggling to make the game a bit visible, but I haven't managed to make any viral clips or trailers that gives us the desired 5000 wishlists in a day.

Anyways, we released the demo some days ago and the feedback from the first players has been awesome! We know the game is great and fun...but we still didn't reach the 1000 wishlists, and that's why I thought I could ask for help. :)

https://preview.redd.it/rmh8i2l6c7vh1.png?width=1443&format=png&auto=webp&s=337b925139e6100052cded9a6f96b3eafd2fd2c2

So please, help us. We just need 150 wishlists to reach 1000, which is like the minimal minimal number to attend a Steam Fest. You can try the game, and we're sure you'll love it if you like this kind of games. But if not, please, just help us not to fall into oblivion. :)

Some of the comments we had so far:

* "wow the music is spot on . the demo is amazing . i can see the love the developer pt into this game . "
* "Rating: 9/10 Really cool graphics and style, I really enjoy the way how every explosion feels very powerful."
* "Excellent demo! -Rocking synthwave tunes -Neon pulsing retro 80s vector/wireframe graphics -Tight, responsive controls -Variety of objectives to do that keep the game feeling fresh -Upgrade system -Great variety of ships/weapons/powerups -Shooting feels good and rewarding -Insta wish-listed!"

https://reddit.com/link/1x4rxqf/video/f4q8zzzgc7vh1/player

* "I just wanted to say "Thank you " for Geometry Rift:Apocalypse. This game is absolutely fantastic, and i'm looking foreward to the release next year. Thank you also for your hard work."

Well, I hope you all can help us a little. :)

Thanks a lot in advance!

comments.author: thundergenie
comments.body: A first game made with your son over almost a year is a win already. 850 wishlists without a viral clip means real people found it one by one. Good luck with the last 150 before the fest.

replies.author: awezoomstudios
replies.body: Thanks. It's not our first game together, but it's going to be our first commercial **finished** release. We'll cross our fingers! :)

comments.author: IntelligentDot2924
comments.body: I actually like bullet hells so sure.
